cues.text: This diff changes how weather retry failed calls.
Retry settings now live in one options object.
Only server errors are retried, never client mistakes.
And each wait is twice as long as the one before.
The dashboard still talks to the weather API.
The API caches every forecast for a minute.
A new retry policy now wraps the weather provider calls.
The old fixed delay is gone.
A user opens the dashboard.
The first attempt reaches the provider and gets a 503.
The API waits briefly, then tries again.
The user sees the forecast appear.
Run the retry tests.
They cover a 503 that recovers on the second try.
They also check the retry limit and client errors.
Waits grow from 200 milliseconds.
On the settings page, nothing looks different.
The city list now shows retried requests.
Saving a city works as before.
And a toast confirms recovered requests.
Before, every failure waited one second and tried again.
After, the helper retries only what can recover.
Each wait doubles, so a busy provider gets room.
Same call sites, safer behaviour.
Here is the weather dashboard after the change.
The retried column is new.
Success rate stays above ninety-nine percent.
That is the whole change.
